text: Hino e yimɓe ɓen, e daabeeji ɗin, e neemoraaɗi ɗin (gelooɗi, na'i, e dammi), ɗi nooneeji mun kadi seerti. Anndee ko mawninta fii Alla, o hula Mo, ko annduɓe Mo ɓen; tawde ɓe anndii sifaaji e sari'aaji e hujjaajji ɓannginɗi kattal Makko. Pellet, Alla ko Fooluɗo Mo fooletake, Haforanoowo kala tuubuɗo e jeyaaɓe Makko ɓen.
